Actors Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn, Tiger Shroff receive FDA notices over Vimal ad

The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued show-cause notices to actors Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn, and Tiger Shroff concerning their endorsement of Vimal Elaichi pan masala. The notices were issued by the FDA, led by Tukaram Mundhe, for promoting a product that is not permitted to be advertised. The FDA is investigating the matter and has stated that the actors' involvement in the advertisement is under scrutiny.
